article.title: The Fourth Schedule
article.content:
FourthThe Fourth Schedule

[THE FOURTH SCHEDULE.] Omitted by the Information Technology (Amendment) Act, 2008 (10 of 2009), s. 50 (w.e.f. 27-10-2009).
Note: this Schedule had carried the amendments to the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934 made by section 94.
